item.mi_overclock_addon.overclock_memory: Inserted in an electric machine's overdrive module slot.
Retains half of the efficiency when recipes change, and prevents idle efficiency loss.
Even a simple feedback loop can remember the machine's rhythm.
item.mi_overclock_addon.persistent_overc: Inserted in an electric machine's overdrive module slot.
Retains all efficiency when recipes change, and prevents idle efficiency loss.
Keeps the machine's working rhythm intact.
item.mi_overclock_addon.quantum_overcloc: Inserted in an electric machine's overdrive module slot.
Maintains maximum efficiency as long as the machine has power.
Precise timing control keeps the machine at full speed.
